response.sql: SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) as total_income, CAST(SUM(income.amount) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT CAST(SUM(income.amount) AS FLOAT) FROM income INNER JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id) as fraction_of_total FROM income INNER JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id GROUP BY major.college;

assumptions.assumption: Include income records where the major's college is NULL as a valid group value, rather than excluding them. The request does not explicitly filter on college being non-NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude income records where the major's college is NULL, on the reasoning that 'for each college' implies only defined colleges should be reported.
alternatives.sql: SELECT major.college, SUM(income.amount) as total_income, CAST(SUM(income.amount) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT CAST(SUM(income.amount) AS FLOAT) FROM income INNER JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.college IS NOT NULL) as fraction_of_total FROM income INNER JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY major.college;
